mapper.select: select f.id,f.equipment_id,e.name equipment_name,e.image,e.brand,e.daily_rate,e.deposit, (e.status=1 and c.status=1) available,f.created_at from rental_favorite f join rental_equipment e on e.id=f.equipment_id join rental_category c on c.id=e.category_id where f.customer_id=#{customerId} order by f.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
